description: Sunset Strip's GTA 6 clip maker turns a GTA 6 moment into a vertical short for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels: word-by-word captions (9 styles), facecam layouts, zoom, slow motion, freeze frames, replays, wanted stars, Mission Passed and Mission Failed cards, 11 sound effects, hooks and captions in 7 languages. Anyone can try every tool on a sample short with no sign-in; uploading your own clip and editing it is free with an account; downloading needs the Clipper plan (US$7.99 a month or US$59.99 a year, 150 shorts a month) or a 40-short pack (US$9). Returns the steps, prices and link.
name: get_clip_maker
title: GTA 6 clip maker: edit a short free, pay to download
